001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.file;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
005
006/**
007 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput> }.
008 * Creates a file output provider. Deferred as a <code>LogProvider</code> (rather than
009 * building the file output directly) so that config - in particular the alerts config
010 * offers - is available to pass into the concrete output's constructor instead of
011 * only reaching it later through the output's start call.
012 * <table class="table">
013 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
014 * <tr>
015 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
016 * <th>Type</th>
017 * <th>Required</th>
018 * <th>Default</th>
019 * <th>Description</th>
020 * </tr>
021 * <tr>
022 * <td><code>{@value PROPERTY_uri }</code></td>
023 * <td><code>URI</code></td>
024 * <td><code>false</code></td>
025 * <td><code>null</code></td>
026 * <td>File uri.</td>
027 * </tr>
028 * <tr>
029 * <td><code>{@value PROPERTY_fileName }</code></td>
030 * <td><code>String</code></td>
031 * <td><code>false</code></td>
032 * <td><code>null</code></td>
033 * <td>File name.</td>
034 * </tr>
035 * <tr>
036 * <td><code>{@value PROPERTY_append }</code></td>
037 * <td><code>Boolean</code></td>
038 * <td><code>false</code></td>
039 * <td><code>null</code></td>
040 * <td>Whether or not to append to existing file.</td>
041 * </tr>
042 * <tr>
043 * <td><code>{@value PROPERTY_prudent }</code></td>
044 * <td><code>Boolean</code></td>
045 * <td><code>false</code></td>
046 * <td><code>null</code></td>
047 * <td>Logback prudent mode where files are locked on each write.</td>
048 * </tr>
049 * <tr>
050 * <td><code>{@value PROPERTY_bufferSize }</code></td>
051 * <td><code>Integer</code></td>
052 * <td><code>true</code></td>
053 * <td>{@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput#DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE }</td>
054 * <td>Buffer size in bytes.</td>
055 * </tr>
056 * </table>
057 */
058public final class FileOutputBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<FileOutputBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput>> {
059
060        /**
061         * The properties to be retrieved from config will have
062         * this prefix.
063         */
064        static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = "logging.output.{name}.";
065        
066        /**
067         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_uri } = java.net.URI</code> File uri.
068         */
069        static final String PROPERTY_uri = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "uri";
070        /**
071         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_fileName } = java.lang.String</code> File name.
072         */
073        static final String PROPERTY_fileName = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "fileName";
074        /**
075         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_append } = java.lang.Boolean</code> Whether or not to append to existing file.
076         */
077        static final String PROPERTY_append = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "append";
078        /**
079         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_prudent } = java.lang.Boolean</code> Logback prudent mode where files are locked on each write.
080         */
081        static final String PROPERTY_prudent = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "prudent";
082        /**
083         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_bufferSize } = java.lang.Integer</code> Buffer size in bytes.
084         */
085        static final String PROPERTY_bufferSize = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "bufferSize";
086        
087        private final String propertyPrefix;
088        final String property_uri;
089        final String property_fileName;
090        final String property_append;
091        final String property_prudent;
092        final String property_bufferSize;
093        
094        private final java.lang.String name;
095        private java.net.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable URI uri = null;
096        private java.lang.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable String fileName = null;
097        private java.lang.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable Boolean append = null;
098        private java.lang.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable Boolean prudent = null;
099        private java.lang.Integer bufferSize = io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput.DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE;
100        
101        /**
102         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput> }.
103         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.output.{name}.</code>. Name of output not file name.
104         */
105        public FileOutputBuilder(
106                        java.lang.String name
107                        ) {
108                java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
109                                "name", name
110                        );
111                this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
112                this.name = name;
113                property_uri = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_uri, prefixParameters);
114                property_fileName = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_fileName, prefixParameters);
115                property_append = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_append, prefixParameters);
116                property_prudent = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_prudent, prefixParameters);
117                property_bufferSize = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_bufferSize, prefixParameters);
118        }
119
120
121        
122        /**
123         * Sets uri.
124         * File uri.
125         * Default is <code>null</code>.
126         * @param uri <code>{@value #PROPERTY_uri } = java.net.URI</code> File uri.
127         * @return this builder.
128         */
129        public FileOutputBuilder uri(java.net.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable URI uri) {
130                this.uri = uri;
131                return this;
132        }
133        
134        /**
135         * Sets fileName.
136         * File name.
137         * Default is <code>null</code>.
138         * @param fileName <code>{@value #PROPERTY_fileName } = java.lang.String</code> File name.
139         * @return this builder.
140         */
141        public FileOutputBuilder fileName(java.lang.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable String fileName) {
142                this.fileName = fileName;
143                return this;
144        }
145        
146        /**
147         * Sets append.
148         * Whether or not to append to existing file.
149         * Default is <code>null</code>.
150         * @param append <code>{@value #PROPERTY_append } = java.lang.Boolean</code> Whether or not to append to existing file.
151         * @return this builder.
152         */
153        public FileOutputBuilder append(java.lang.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable Boolean append) {
154                this.append = append;
155                return this;
156        }
157        
158        /**
159         * Sets prudent.
160         * Logback prudent mode where files are locked on each write.
161         * Default is <code>null</code>.
162         * @param prudent <code>{@value #PROPERTY_prudent } = java.lang.Boolean</code> Logback prudent mode where files are locked on each write.
163         * @return this builder.
164         */
165        public FileOutputBuilder prudent(java.lang.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable Boolean prudent) {
166                this.prudent = prudent;
167                return this;
168        }
169        
170        /**
171         * Sets <strong>required</strong> bufferSize.
172         * Buffer size in bytes.
173         * Default is {@value io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput#DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE }.
174         * @param bufferSize <code>{@value #PROPERTY_bufferSize } = java.lang.Integer</code> Buffer size in bytes.
175         * @return this builder.
176         */
177        public FileOutputBuilder bufferSize(java.lang.Integer bufferSize) {
178                this.bufferSize = bufferSize;
179                return this;
180        }
181        
182        /**
183         * Creates {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput> } from this builder.
184         * @return {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput> }.
185         */
186        public io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput> build() {
187                try {
188                        return io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput.of(
189                                        this.name
190                                        , this.uri
191                                        , this.fileName
192                                        , this.append
193                                        , this.prudent
194                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_bufferSize, this.bufferSize)
195                                        );
196                }
197                catch (IllegalArgumentException | LogProperty.PropertyMissingException e) {
198                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
199                }
200        }
201        
202        @Override
203        public FileOutputBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
204                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
205                var _uri = properties.forKey(property_uri).ofURI().or(this.uri).validateIfError(__v);
206                var _fileName = properties.forKey(property_fileName).ofString().or(this.fileName).validateIfError(__v);
207                var _append = properties.forKey(property_append).ofBoolean().or(this.append).validateIfError(__v);
208                var _prudent = properties.forKey(property_prudent).ofBoolean().or(this.prudent).validateIfError(__v);
209                var _bufferSize = properties.forKey(property_bufferSize).ofInt().or(this.bufferSize).validate(__v);
210                __v.validate();
211                this.uri = _uri.valueOrNull();
212                this.fileName = _fileName.valueOrNull();
213                this.append = _append.valueOrNull();
214                this.prudent = _prudent.valueOrNull();
215                this.bufferSize = _bufferSize.value();
216                return this;
217        }
218        
219        /**
220         * The interpolated property prefix: {@value #PROPERTY_PREFIX}.
221         * @return resolved prefix which should end with a "<code>.</code>".
222         */
223        @Override
224        public String propertyPrefix() {
225                return this.propertyPrefix;
226        }
227        
228}
